corrections.text: The Overview says the analysis compares the vendors' rules "with notices issued between August and November 2026". One of the notices discussed was issued outside that window: GitHub's changelog post announcing the first Copilot round is dated July 31, 2026, for the September 1 deprecation (32 days). The other dated notices in the article (September 18, September 30, October 14, October 15) fall inside the window.

The article counts 365 days for the Assistants API notice from "August 26, 2025", the date in the sentence on OpenAI's deprecations page ("On August 26th, 2025, we notified developers using the Assistants API ..."). The heading of the same entry on that page reads "2025-08-20: Assistants API"; counted from August 20 the interval to the August 26, 2026 shutdown would be 371 days. The page does not explain the difference. Either way the notice was about one year, and the figure is the Herald's own arithmetic.
